* No black-bordered card with a D-E mark prints exactly these words: the Players Committee's D-E1 card ([[Dengar (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]]) says “While present, may reduce Han’s forfeit to zero here”. Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Dengar (Revised)]] (December 1999).
